label: Fixed 30-Day Month for Monthly Payroll
description: When enabled, monthly Salary Slips use a fixed 30-day divisor. Full calendar months pay 100% before LWP and absence deductions; partial periods use eligible payable days / 30.

label: 30-Day Salary Proration Mode
description: Deduction: 30 minus unpaid days. Attendance: actual payable days when some unpaid leave exists. Automatic: switches to Attendance when unpaid days reach crossover.

label: 30-Day Proration Crossover (Unpaid Days)
description: When unpaid-day equivalents reach this threshold, Automatic switches to Attendance mode.
